message.jaymoskingdoms.skeleton_curse.to: The Skeleton Lord's laughter settles in your bones. Die with it in you and you'll rise as one of his.
message.jaymoskingdoms.skeleton_curse.cu: The gold burns through you, and the laughter in your bones goes quiet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.turned.cur: The Lord's curse kept its promise. You feel light. There's very little left of you to feel.
